segments.text: An example is a specific case or model
used to show what something is like
or how it works.
It is a clear illustration
that helps explain a rule,
an idea,
or a general statement.
We use examples every day
to make things easier to understand.
For instance, a teacher might use
the story of a famous scientist like Marie Curie
as an example of perseverance.
A cookbook provides a recipe
as an example of how to make a dish.
The most common understanding of an example
is this helpful tool for teaching and clarity.
An interesting fact is that our brains
are naturally wired to learn from examples.
Studies show that people
often understand a new concept faster
and remember it better
when it is presented with a concrete example
rather than just an abstract description.
This is why stories and real-world cases
are such powerful tools for communication.
